info.name: OpenEMR AI Clinical Co-Pilot — Agent API
info.description:
Exercises the OpenEMR AI Clinical Co-Pilot agent endpoints end to end.

Run order:
  1. Mint dev token — POST dev_mint.php to obtain a pid-scoped JWT. The test script saves it to the `jwt` collection variable, so run this first; every later request reuses it via `Authorization: Bearer {{jwt}}`.
  2. Get patient summary.
  3 / 3b / 3c. Chart reads (encounters, medications, chart search).
  4. Ask (buffered) — the sidecar's /ask.
  5. Ask (streaming SSE) — the sidecar's /ask/stream.

IMPORTANT: the dev mint endpoint (dev_mint.php) is DISABLED BY DEFAULT and returns 404 unless the dev-mint gate is enabled (set OE_AI_AGENT_DEV_MINT=1, or dev_token_mint in the module's config.local.php). It bypasses session/CSRF/ACL by design and is for the SYNTHETIC demo only — NEVER enable it on real PHI.

Point `openemr_base_url` and `sidecar_base_url` at your local dev stack or a Railway demo deployment via the collection variables.
